title: Why ALL OF BENGAL Is Celebrating Mamta’s DOWNFALL
description:
In this video, we discuss how the people of Bengal voted for BJP and rejected TMC. We also enjoy some of the funniest memes and reactions on Mamata Banerjee and TMC after the election results. Along with that, we talk about Bengal’s rich history and how the state once played a major cultural and economic role in India. Even during British rule, Bengal was extremely important and Kolkata was the capital of British India for many years. We also discuss how many major movements started from Bengal and how many great personalities were connected to the state. After that, we look at the history of political violence under TMC and finally discuss why Bengal chose BJP. Despite the defeat, Mamata Banerjee still does not seem ready to resign.

An article by Dr. Ryan Baidya introduces the concept of defensive democracy, a legal framework designed to prevent political entities from using democratic institutions to dismantle the system from within.  By examining recent events in West Bengal and the United States, the author argues that modern threats arise when defeated leaders refuse to accept the electoral mandate and obstruct the peaceful transfer of power.  The article critiques the current legal gaps in India, noting that while parties must pledge allegiance to democracy, there are few mechanisms to hold them accountable for subsequent constitutional sabotage.  Drawing on the German model, the article proposes a system of graduated sanctions, ranging from public censures to the ultimate dissolution of a party.  Ultimately, the article asserts that a constitution must include deterrent measures to ensure that parties that reject the democratic process forfeit their right to its protections.
